name: M3_PDS016MI_GetDailyCap
description: Retrieve daily capacity for a specific work center, date, and time interval. The call returns one capacity bucket within a facility, including company, work center, shift, start and end time, nominal number of hours, capacity type (man-hours or machine hours), utilization rate, number of machines, and, when configured, alternate capacity and its unit of measure. The call is read-only and does not change any capacity definitions.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the work center daily capacity record to retrieve is defined.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center whose daily capacity record is to be retrieved.

inputParameters.name: DATE
inputParameters.description: Calendar date of the daily capacity record to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: STIM
inputParameters.description: Start time of the daily capacity interval to retrieve on the specified date.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number to which the daily capacity record belongs.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the daily capacity for the work center is defined.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Work center for which this daily capacity record is defined.

outputParameters.name: DATE
outputParameters.description: Calendar date of the daily capacity record.

outputParameters.name: STIM
outputParameters.description: Start time of the daily capacity interval on the specified date.

outputParameters.name: SHFC
outputParameters.description: Shift to which this daily capacity record applies.

outputParameters.name: ETIM
outputParameters.description: End time of the daily capacity interval on the specified date.

outputParameters.name: AVEF
outputParameters.description: Utilization rate expressing net capacity as a percentage of rated capacity for this work center and day.

outputParameters.name: GHRS
outputParameters.description: Nominal number of capacity hours for this work center and day.

outputParameters.name: PCAP
outputParameters.description: Capacity type indicating whether capacity is expressed in machine hours or man-hours.

outputParameters.name: WCNM
outputParameters.description: Number of machines included in the work center for this daily capacity record.

outputParameters.name: CPTY
outputParameters.description: Rated capacity per unit and shift for the work center on this day.

outputParameters.name: ACAP
outputParameters.description: Rated alternate capacity per unit and shift for the work center on this day.

outputParameters.name: RCUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used for the alternate capacity for this work center and day.
